title: Velox
extract:
Velox is  Protea's signature automatic sidearm with high fire rate, innate 20% Ammo Efficiency, and faster reload from an empty magazine. In the hands of Protea, Velox's Ammo Efficiency is increased to 40%.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Reloads 50% faster from a fully depleted magazine.
Can use the Velox-exclusive  Velox Conclusion mod.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Innate 20% Ammo Efficiency.
When wielded by  Protea/ Protea Prime, ammo efficiency is increased to 40%.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High magazine size (62)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Very high ammo max (434)
Very high fire rate (15.00 attacks/sec)
Above average status chance (22.00%)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x))
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average crit chance (14.00%)
Low damage per shot (26.68)
Low total damage (24)
Very low reload speed (2.60 s)
Low crit multiplier (1.80x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

 Velox (Normal Attack), compared to  Velox Prime (Normal Attack):
Lower base damage per projectile (24.00 vs. 27.00)

Lower  Slash damage ( 11.52 vs.  12.96)
Lower total damage (24 vs. 27)
Lower base critical multiplier (1.80x vs. 2.00x)
Lower base status chance (22.00% vs. 32.00%)
Lower average damage per tap (26.68 vs. 30.78)
Lower burst DPS (400.32 vs. 523.26)
Lower sustained DPS (245.74 vs. 320.73)
Lower fire rate (15.00 attacks/sec vs. 17.00 attacks/sec)
Smaller magazine (62 vs. 70)
Smaller max ammo capacity (434 vs. 520)
Less polarities ( vs. )

Acquisition
The Velox's component parts can be acquired from within the Granum Void; the Barrel from Rotation C, the Receiver from Rotation C of Extended Granum Void. The main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. All components, except for the blueprint, can be traded between players.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Ammo efficiency is based on number of shots fired, and the free shot interval is carried over between magazine reloads.

Bugs
Although its noise level is listed as "alarming", the weapon is actually silent and behaves like other silent weapons. However, it will still break  Prowl insibility unless the  Suppress mod is equipped.
Having a Glaive (Weapon Type) equipped visually breaks the origin of bullets, they will be fired from a top left/right diagonal position of where the actual gun and barrel are. Still present in Hotfix 42.0.11 (2026-05-14).
